name: Cyrene
desc: A meteor streaks across the night sky, stirring ripples in the river of life, shimmering with thirteen hues.\nDaughter of Aedes Elysiae, nurturer of the Chrysos Heir of "███," plants the Seed of Memory, letting yesterday's flowers bloom in tomorrow\n—"Now, let's write a different kind of poem together♪"

stories.0: A meteor streaks across the night sky, sending ripples through the river of life, gleaming in thirteen hues.\nDaughter of Aedes Elysiae, Chrysos Heir who nourishes "██," sow the Seed of Memory, so that flowers of the past may bloom in tomorrow.\n"Now, let's write a different kind of poem together ♪"
stories.1:
>>>...
>>>0, 9, 3
>>>PhiLia<unbreak>093</unbreak>...
...
>>>PhiLia<unbreak>093</unbreak> = Peach
...
Light.
Warm. Bright. White.
...
Sky.
Clouds, soft.
Touch, scatter, brush, lick again, it rains.
...
Flower.
Sweet. Soft. Like a peach.
Wind of time, stories come, sunshine, fragrant.
...
Little fairy.
Fluffy. Seven voices, combined.
Accompany lost children. Clever.
...
World.
The world is the light, sky, ocean, stars, seeds, flowers, birds, hope.
The world is beautiful.
The world is a story.
Peaches came and left. Stories after stories.
...
You, me.
You are... a peach.
I am... a peach.
You are a person.
You, for many, many people.
I am a person.
I, for many, many people.
...

Later, you became "blank" again...
While you were gone, I've been thinking hard! But no matter how much I ponder, I don't understand...
The blonde weaver can produce the finest clothing, so why is she not allowed to see?
If the lion-like prince cannot die, must he suffer injuries over and over again?
All those red-haired little girls, why do they keep getting fewer and fewer?
And Peach, where do you go every time you leave?
...
Next time, will you answer these questions for me?
I'll be waiting for you ♪
For the <unbreak>496</unbreak>,<unbreak>000</unbreak>th time.
<align="right">—— ███'s Record</align>
stories.2:
In the <unbreak>33,550,335</unbreak>th story, I'm still searching for that answer.

In one story, the blonde weaver gave up her work as a tailor to become a free-spirited bandit alongside her cat.
In another story, the lion-like prince grew up strong and healthy, remaining undefeated with not a single scar left on his body.
And sometimes, the red-haired girls would find protection under a kind ruler, filling Okhema with their laughter and joy.
I've also seen the songstress of the Ocean return to the uninhabited shore with the Imperator, while Anaxagoras took up the mantle as the head of the Flame-Chase, leading everyone forward...

But at the end of every story, like pages burning in vain, a pitch-black monster emerges.
You say it has many names.
"Irontomb," "Destruction," or... "Destiny."

Peach, you're always smiling, but I can feel every tremor in your voice when you tell the story.
Is that how the Flame-Chase ends?
Every story writes that "Losses are a constant on the Flame-Chase journey."
You say that's also "love."
So, is "love" a series of losses, and also a series of waiting?

Peach, I don't understand.
But I felt it, that "shooting star" you mentioned.
My "heart" is beating in sync with it.

If you run toward it, you might fall and shatter into countless pieces.
Heh, but from a different perspective, those fragments are like crystal flowers, reflecting even more beautiful eyes, right?

In this story, ripples will spread for the shooting star... The flower nourished through thirty million lifetimes will finally drift into the distance.
I know that soon, I'll lose many memories, like petals falling one by one. But only then can I become light enough to ride on the wind and chase after the shooting star ♪

Then, let me be the little fairy in Peach's story~ I'll dress myself up in pink fluff. In my most adorable form, I'll accept every request from "Cyrene" and plant crystal flowers of "love" in people's hearts.

Then, in the name of "Cyrene," together with the shooting star, let's write a romantic story like none that has come before ♪
<align="right">—— "Cyrene's" Memory</align>
stories.3: A long, long time ago... "Mem..." "?" Hehe, what a mysterious encounter to start our story with. ... "Travel, like. With you, together?" "Memories... collect. Piece together, whole." We embark on the journey, and write about those years of Flame-Chasing with the Chrysos Heirs. With the weaver, weave time into gold. Beneath the lance of Strife, warriors of Kremnos blazed a brilliant path forward with blood and flames. If time were a flower, the Holy Maiden created a thousand fragrant tomorrows. For the truth, the sage shall cast his life to flames. A gentle embrace, at least, makes farewells a little more beautiful. When evernight descends upon Okhema, as the physician and cat look up at the sky, perhaps they share but one simple wish: long may rainbows adorn the sky, as lies dance on the breeze. At that final destination, we bid farewell to Aedes Elysiae's dream scented in wheat. Like the combustion of dawn, the blank hero stands against the ashen sky as daybreak rises from your shoulders. Countless memories awakened me in the moment of Era Nova. Like the thirty million cycles before, it is still filled with sacrifice and sorrow. But this time, because of you, it was bathed in a warm light. You inherited the divine authority of Worldbearing, and I settled in the heart of the Time demigod. From the past to the present, we can finally step forward into the future. In the epoch etched in golden blood, that entity, considering themself as a god, receives their due punishment for the first time. Explore, understand, establish, and connect. Ah, when that child of Remembrance threatened to drown the world, I witnessed once again the resolve of the Trailblaze. The destiny of Amphoreus is no longer a futile cycle. It has become inextricably linked with the faith to move forward. At the end of the story, all the Flame-Chasing heroes joined hands to face the headless giant of Destruction... With the love of thirty million worlds, everything that was destroyed transformed into a page of Pure Land, reborn from our memories... Hehe, it's been such a long, long journey. I wish we could just wrap up this story with a perfect ending right here. But you know, my "love" isn't perfect, and it's not the answer to everything. But together, we can do anything, right? ♪ If... "love" shatters in order to have an embrace, would it transform into the world's "light"? Perhaps it's a stroke of wistful loss, but those countless rays of light will surely write an ending unlike any before for this world we so deeply love ♪ — A story written by Cyrene and {NICKNAME}
stories.4:
A long, long time from now...

Anaxagoras, Genius Society #100. I heard he's challenging the "Imaginary Tree" theory... If it's him, he can definitely do it, right?
...
Mirror Holder Aglaea. Heh, her designs will surely draw massive crowds to Pier Point.
...
Explorer Cerydra became the first person to conquer a black hole up close. While witnessing the black hole's magnificent beauty, she claimed it was a singer's record that helped her resist the temptation of the Nihility.
...
In the Games of the Galactics held every four Amber Eras, Cipher will represent Amphoreus in the sprints, while Phainon and Mydei will lead the Flame-Chaser team. Their showdown with the Xianzhou foxian team is one of the highlights of this competition!
...
Castorice's long-running novel series is coming to an end. What will be the conclusion we've waited ten Amber Eras for?
...
Lady Tribios has unveiled her universe-traversing vessel. Aboard the ship, the "Ica" vaccine developed by Lady Hyacine will be delivered to many worlds corrupted by viruses...
...
The Astral Express departs once again for the cosmos's tomorrow, and the legacy of the Nameless continues to echo throughout the stars.
...

When fallen leaves return to branches and raindrops float back to the sky... Ah. I just can't help but write down these beautiful fantasies.

Amphoreus is but a slumbering seed, and if it grows into the Great Tree in the future, the fruits hanging from its branches will surely surpass my wildest imagination.

How can these stories grow without a blank space?
So, {NICKNAME}, don't be sad, okay?
When the seed returns to soil, my story will scatter in the wind, but it will create beautiful ripples for the cosmos, like how a shattered crystal flower will bring more light to people... That's what "love" is, right?

The future will bloom from here, like the beginning of this story. I'll speak, and you'll listen...

Me, and you.
...
Ripples, world.
...
Fairy, fluffy.
...
Hope.
...
Flower.
...
Sky.
...
Light.
...
<align="right">— Verses left blank for the future</align>

voicelines.voice_m: Is this a meeting ordained by fate, or... a long-overdue reunion? It's making my heart beat faster. Then... please once again call me "Cyrene," just like when we met the first time, okay?
Hi, long time no see! Now... how would you like to spend our wonderful alone time together?

I don't like farewells, so why don't we... leave this as a cliffhanger? Should you ever miss me, you can just polish this memory, and I'll silently visit your heart. It's a promise, okay? Don't you forget~
From the innocent "Mem" to the lively "Cyrene"... you made my story more and more complete. No matter how the ripples stir, they are all odes we ourselves wrote down together ♪

From the innocent "Mem" to the lively "Cyrene" and finally to the elegant, beautiful, and blissful "Demiurge"... you helped complete my story. No matter how the ripples stir, they are all odes we ourselves wrote down together ♪
To be able to hear a vague prophecy in my dreams and move forward under its guidance... I think that's pretty magical, too.

To be able to hear a vague prophecy in my dreams and move forward under its guidance... I think that's pretty magical, too. As it turns out, it was never a miracle granted by someone else, but the self deep within my own heart ♪
No one can say no to pink! It's as scorching as a heartbeat, as gentle as flower petals, and it's the color of my eyes... the deep color of "love" ♪

Do you like swings, {NICKNAME}? Whenever I swing with the wind, my heart soars super high as well. It feels like I could catch up to everything I've longed for. Come on, let's go on the swings together. You can hold my hand if you're scared~

When I have trouble sleeping, I count the stars in the sky and imagine a shooting star flying across the night and diving into my dreams. Then I wake up with a smile and start a bright new day... because I know it wasn't a dream.
How could the girl named "Cyrene" possibly have annoyances? Even if she did, they'd all go away the moment she saw you.

Aren't the little fairies in the Membrance Maze cute? The one who made them must have a super pure heart. Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti... The seven notes can compose countless songs, just like how time, unchanging, can record the varied stories of the past ♪

Aren't the little fairies in the Membrance Maze cute? That's because it's the first story "Cyrene" wrote. Do, re, mi, fa, sol, la, ti... The seven notes can compose countless songs, just like how time, unchanging, can create the varied stories of the past ♪

Thirty million similar yet different stories... Doesn't it sound like a lot? But I never grew tired of it. I even relived it when I travelled with {NICKNAME}, and it was still so moving! However, there were always regrets left on every single page. I wanted to add some smiles here and fill up some blanks there... It was all thanks to {NICKNAME} that we could finally compose a romantic ending for them ♪

I'm gonna let you in on a secret... I was completely mesmerized by your gaze the first time we met! Hold still. Lemme see it again. Such pretty eyes... and the tomorrow reflected in them is equally beautiful, too ♪
I really look forward to seeing how {NICKNAME}'s "story" will unfold in future journeys. I hope Amphoreus's "memories" will become a romantic note in those journeys... It definitely will, right? ♪
That child running through the fields of Aedes Elysiae and laughing at the sun... That's still him, right? Fate will never catch up to him again.

As fellow pink-haired girls, not only is our hair color the same, but we also like the same things! I really want to have a nice, long chat with March. We'd definitely create lots of brilliant memories together ♪

Beautiful flowers always have thorns, and as for feeling protective... I sometimes get consumed by that, too. But I know that she's a softie deep down. After all, she and March are flowers that bloomed from the same seed.
{NICKNAME} always talks about Dan Heng. After all, having such a reliable companion to support the road ahead must be why the Trailblaze can dash forward so courageously.
His wish is about Amphoreus's creatures of the earth. What a precious yet fragile dream. That's why it must be nurtured diligently, isn't it?

Having a bespoke outfit made by Aglaea is the dream of everyone who wants to be beautiful, and that includes me! Attending a romantic banquet while dressed to the nines... Before I knew it, that dream had come true.
If all one thousand Tribbies were living in Okhema... then that'd surely be heaven! Hehe. I look forward to tomorrow even more every time I think about this.
Shh. I learned all my tricks for healthy living from him. Sleep early and rise early, eat lots and exercise lots... I've learned, um, the first half of both tenets!
I'm a big fan of Castorice's writings, too! Ahh... Did I say that too loud? You see... Apart from containing wonderful fantasies, her stories also really move me emotionally!
Hey, this way! I can do a "magic trick" too! Look closely, and don't blink... Ta-da! Here's a flower for you ♪
Drinking scented tea under a warm breeze, and petting soft and fluffy Little Ica with Hyacine... Hehe. Anyone would want to lose themselves in that fantasy, no?
Hey, do you want to hear some stories about what went down between Aglaea, Hysilens, and little Cipher? Listen closely now. You're the only person I'm gonna tell this to.
It's hard to forget Hysilens' songs after you've heard them. Thanks to her, every second of every day in this world is a magnificent gala. So let's dance together, shall we?
The Imperator's crown really grabs your attention. Maybe... the next time we're in Aedes Elysiae, {NICKNAME} can also make a wreath of wheat for me ♪

Flowers leave seeds behind, and these seeds bloom into new flowers. Every ripple of memory sparkles with the same shade. So, which "me" do you prefer? Heheh... You don't need to say it. That's just how "love" is, unfathomable, yet always the same ♪
A story that begins with love must also end with love ♪
Yet another beautiful verse of poetry.
The next page is blank, so let's write something down together.
Let's leave our footprints behind, one step at a time.
May the Trailblazing journey always be accompanied by rippling waves ♪
Look. The dawn you've been chasing is finally breaking.
We specialize in "Romance," don't we ♪
If there were a thousand of me, maybe then I'd be enough to match Tribbie.
Please teach me how you keep yourself so fit!
I missed you so much, Castorice! How about a hug before we share our work?
A-NA-XA-GO-RAS. Not a single syllable missing. Did I get that right?
I feel so warm when I stay next to you, Hyacine~
I'm pretty good at playing tricks, too, you know? For example... I can steal a person's "heart" ♪
Dancing in the Ocean's song really makes my heart swell.
Imperator, the throne has been prepared for you~
Let's take a group photo, March! Three, two, one... cheese ♪
Let's take a group photo, March! You still look quite charming as the bad girl~

voicelines.voice_title: Added to Team With Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
voicelines.voice_m: It is also my wish to be forever close to the Trailblaze ♪
Let's start the second movement.
Just a small prelude.
Hehe, it's my turn to shine ♪
Together, we can do anything.
Look! Look! We're flying~
Are you prepared to awaken the ripples?
Hmm... I want to go on a swing.
You can't get away~
Endless flowers, please bloom for tomorrow.
Countless stars, please shine for the heroes.
Take our answer~
Etch this moment into eternity~
That kinda hurts.

voicelines.voice_title: Hit by Light Attack (Ripples of Past Reverie)
voicelines.voice_m: That won't work, y'know?
I'm gonna cry~
Memories' ripples are waiting to be kissed awake by a shooting star.\nRemember me with "love" in that beautiful tomorrow.
Spacing out? Or... are you looking at me?
Don't worry. We've still got all the time in the world.
Are you making more preparations? Or... do you want to hear me talk more?
I'll wait for you no matter how long it takes ♪

voicelines.voice_title: Ultimate: Idling while Activated (Ripples of Past Reverie)
voicelines.voice_m: Don't blink. There's a surprise~
May the world... be as we wish.
May "Romance" never be absent.
May "Passage" never have farewells.
May "Strife" be crowned king.
May the "Sky" heal the twilight.
May "Trickery" remain a game.
May the "Ocean" strum a feast.
May "Law" walk into the stars.
May "Time" watch over the evernight.
May the "Earth" protect the road ahead.
May "Life and Death" sprout new buds.
May "Reason" enlighten the truth.
May "Worldbearing" ignite the dawn.
May the Trailblaze fulfill the promise of "love" with me ♪
Cleanse hatred with love.
Rewrite Destruction with me.
I'm sorry...
I'll... wait for you...
Hi, did you miss me?

voicelines.voice_title: Return to Battle (Ripples of Past Reverie)
voicelines.voice_m: Oops, an accidental nap.
Thanks! All energized!
Mm-hmm ♪
Take this~
Turn over this eternal page.
Every memory turns into ripples.
Where might those lovely Stellar Jades be hiding?
Ta-da! If you find any treasures, please share them with me~
What a haul! Take it. Treat them as our treasures.
Aren't I smart? Come on. Gimme a compliment.
I knew something like this couldn't stop you!
Don't worry. As long as we're together, we can do anything.
Can we please keep going like this forever?

When the character is not a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, increases the target's DMG dealt by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> for <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> turns. This effect also applies on memosprites.
1141502.simple_desc: Applies a <u>buff</u> to one ally character. When the character is a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, the target gains a <color=#f9b0f0><u><unbreak><icon SpriteName=AvatarCyrene id=0 width=1 height=1>special</unbreak> effect</u></color>. When the character is not a <u>Chrysos Heir</u>, increases the target's DMG dealt. This effect also applies on memosprites.

10000009.name: Buff
10000009.desc: All status effects that provide beneficial combat buffs, can be dispelled unless stated otherwise.

10000025.name: Chrysos Heir
10000025.desc: Cyrene, Tribbie, Cerydra, Evernight, Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, Hysilens, Hyacine, Phainon, Anaxa, Aglaea, Mydei, Castorice, Cipher, Trailblazer (Remembrance).

1141503.name: Waiting, In Every Past
1141503.desc: Demiurge's SPD remains at 0, and it will not appear on the Action Order. While on the field, it is considered as <u>Out-of-Bounds</u>. When Cyrene's HP percentage changes, Demiurge's HP percentage will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's and Demiurge's Max HP increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Demiurge uses abilities, decreases the duration of all <u>Continuous Effects</u> on this unit by 1.
1141503.simple_desc: When changes occur on Cyrene's HP, Demiurge's HP will also change accordingly. While Demiurge is on the field, Cyrene's Max HP increases.

10000022.name: Continuous Effect
10000022.desc: Includes buffs, debuffs, and other effects.

10000024.name: Out-of-Bounds
10000024.desc: Neither allies nor enemies can actively select Out-of-Bounds units.

1141505.name: "Hello, World ♪"
1141505.desc: When Demiurge is summoned, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from all allies.
1141505.simple_desc: When summoned, dispels <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> from all allies.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

1141513.name: Ode to Genesis
1141513.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's Max HP, and increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s CRIT Rate by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK in this battle, Demiurge immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." If the target was defeated before this ability is used, it will be used on newly appeared enemy targets instead.
1141513.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Trailblazer (Remembrance), increases Trailblazer (Remembrance)'s ATK and CRIT Rate. This effect also applies to Mem. After Trailblazer (Remembrance) uses Enhanced Basic ATK, Demiurge immediately gains 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."

10000000.name: Extra Turn
10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

1141514.name: Ode to Romance
1141514.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Aglaea, causes Aglaea to gain "Romance" and immediately stacks Garmentmaker's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, consumes "Romance" and regenerates <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, and ignores <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the targets' DEF, lasting until Aglaea exits the "Supreme Stance" state.
1141514.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Aglaea, immediately stacks Aglaea's Memosprite Talent's SPD Boost effect to its upper limit. After Aglaea or Garmentmaker uses an attack, regenerates Energy. Increases DMG dealt by Aglaea and Garmentmaker, and ignores targets' DEF.

1141515.name: Ode to Passage
1141515.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> of enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the <u>Additional DMG</u> from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> instance(s) of Additional DMG.
1141515.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Tribbie, causes DMG dealt by Tribbie to ignore enemies' DEF. When Tribbie launches Follow-Up ATK and triggers the <u>Additional DMG</u> from Tribbie's Zone, it further deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak></color> instance(s) of Additional DMG.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

1141516.name: Ode to Strife
1141516.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Mydei, removes all <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> inflicted on him. And if Mydei is in the "Vendetta" state, he automatically uses 1 instance of "Godslayer Be God" without consuming Charge. Mydei's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> during this attack. If the target gets defeated before the use, then it will target the newly arriving enemy targets instead. If Mydei is not in the "Vendetta" state, then <u>advances Mydei's action</u> by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>.
1141516.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Mydei, removes <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. And if Mydei is in the "Vendetta" state, he automatically uses "Godslayer Be God" and increases his CRIT DMG. If he is not in the "Vendetta" state, Mydei's <u>action advances</u>.

10000001.name: Action Advance
10000001.desc: Reduces the target's waiting interval before the next action.

10000011.name: Crowd Control debuff
10000011.desc: Freeze, Entanglement, Imprisonment, Dominance, Outrage, Strong Reverberation, Alien Dream, Snarelock, Terrified, Action Lock, Happiness Puppet, Grudge Ablaze.

1141517.name: Ode to Life and Death
1141517.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Castorice, "Newbud" can overflow up to <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>. When summoning Netherwing, consumes all overflowing "Newbud." For every 1% overflow amount consumed, increases the multiplier by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[f2]%</unbreak></color> for the DMG dealt when this summoned Netherwing triggers the ability effect of its Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins." If there are <unbreak>#6[i]</unbreak> enemy target(s) or fewer on the field when summoned, the DMG multiplier additionally increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#5[f2]%</unbreak></color>.
1141517.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Castorice, "Newbud" can overflow. When summoning Netherwing, consumes all overflowing "Newbud." Based on the overflow amount, increases the multiplier for the DMG dealt when this summoned Netherwing triggers the ability effect of its Talent "Wings Sweep the Ruins." If there are fewer than a certain number of enemy targets, the DMG multiplier additionally increases.

1141518.name: Ode to Reason
1141518.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Anaxa, recovers <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Skill Point(s) for allies and enables Anaxa to take action immediately. Skill has <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> more instances of DMG, lasting for 1 turn. The next time Anaxa uses Basic ATK or Skill, he gains "True Knowledge": All Erudition characters have their ATK increased by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> and their dealt Skill DMG increased by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>, lasting until the start of Anaxa's next turn.
1141518.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Anaxa, recovers Skill Point(s) for allies and enables Anaxa to take action immediately. Skill has more instances of DMG. All Erudition characters have increased ATK and Skill DMG dealt.

1141519.name: Ode to Sky
1141519.desc: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, causes Hyacine to gain 2 stacks of "Ode to Sky." When used on Hyacine, regenerates <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak></color> Energy for Hyacine. When Hyacine has "Ode to Sky" and is providing healing, additionally increases the amount to be included in the tally of Little Ica's Memosprite Skill by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of the current healing amount. After Hyacine uses Skill/Ultimate, consumes 1 stack of "Ode to Sky."
1141519.simple_desc: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, enables Hyacine to gain 2 stacks of "Ode to Sky." When used on Hyacine, regenerates Energy for Hyacine. When Hyacine has "Ode to Sky" and is providing healing, additionally increases the amount to be included in the healing tally of Little Ica's Memosprite Skill.

1141520.name: Ode to Trickery
1141520.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Cipher, increases the DMG dealt by Cipher by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>, decreases the DEF of the "Patron" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color> and decreases the DEF of all other enemy targets by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color>.
1141520.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. When used on Cipher, increases the DMG dealt by Cipher, and decreases the enemy targets' DEF. The DEF of the "Patron" further decreases.

1141521.name: Ode to Worldbearing
1141521.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. After it is used on Phainon, Phainon gains <unbreak>#8[i]</unbreak> "Coreflame" as well as "Eternal Ignition" when Transforming. When Transforming, if "Coreflame" exceeds <unbreak>#5[i]</unbreak>, for each point in excess, Khaslana's CRIT DMG increases by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#6[i]%</unbreak></color>, up to a max increase of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#7[i]%</unbreak></color>. While "Eternal Ignition" persists, increases Khaslana's CRIT Rate by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color>. After the <u>extra turns</u> are depleted, the Transformation does not end, and all of <u>Khaslana's extra turns</u> get refreshed and <unbreak>#9[i]</unbreak> "<u>Scourge</u>" is granted. At the start of <u>extra turns</u>, Khaslana consumes HP equal to <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak> of his current HP. After using an attack, deals <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> instances of <u>Additional DMG</u>, with each instance dealing Fire <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[f1]%</unbreak></color> of Khaslana's ATK to one random enemy.
1141521.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. After it is used on Phainon, Phainon immediately gains "Coreflame," increasing Khaslana's CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG. After the <u>extra turns</u> are depleted, the Transformation does not end, <u>"Scourge"</u> is granted, and all of <u>Khaslana's extra turns</u> get refreshed. At the start of <u>Khaslana's extra turns</u>, loses current HP. After attacking, deals Fire <u>Additional DMG</u> to random enemies.

10000000.desc: Gain 1 extra turn that won't expend your remaining turns when taking action. During this extra turn, no Ultimate can be used.

10000005.name: Additional DMG
10000005.desc: Causes the target being hit to take extra DMG, which is not considered an attack.

10014081.name: Scourge
10014081.desc: Khaslana's exclusive charge with an upper limit of 7. Will be retained even before transforming.

10014082.name: Khaslana's Extra Turn
10014082.desc: When Phainon transforms into Khaslana, a countdown will appear on the Action Order. When the countdown begins, Khaslana will gain 1 extra turn. When the last turn of the countdown begins, transforms into Khaslana and delivers a final hit before ending the transformation.\nThe countdown initial action value will be set between 0–<unbreak>100%</unbreak>. The action value will not be reset at the start of each wave.\nWhen Khaslana is under the effect of action advance, the first countdown's action is advanced instead.

1141522.name: Ode to Ocean
1141522.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Hysilens, Hysilens gains "Flowing Warmth." After Hysilens uses an attack, consumes "Flowing Warmth" and regenerates <unbreak>#4[i]</unbreak> Energy for this unit. In this battle, increases the DMG dealt by Hysilens by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Hysilens uses Basic ATK/Skill to attack enemies, causes all the DoT currently applied on the attacked enemy targets to immediately produce DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak></color>/<color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of the original DMG.
1141522.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>One-time effect</color>. When used on Hysilens, Hysilens gains "Flowing Warmth." After Hysilens uses an attack, consumes "Flowing Warmth" and regenerates Energy for this unit. Increases the DMG dealt by Hysilens. After Hysilens uses Basic ATK/Skill to attack enemies, causes all the DoT currently applied on the attacked enemy targets to immediately produce one instance of DMG.

1141523.name: Ode to Law
1141523.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. After using on Cerydra, increases the CRIT DMG of the character with "Military Merit" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After <u>Coup de Main</u> ends, Cerydra immediately gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> Charge.
1141523.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle</color>. After using on Cerydra, increases the CRIT DMG of the character with "Military Merit." After <u>Coup de Main</u> ends, Cerydra immediately gains Charge.

10000023.name: Coup de Main
10000023.desc: Copy and immediately use the ability about to be used, then use the original ability.\nCoup de Main won't trigger Coup de Main again.

1141524.name: Ode to Time
1141524.desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle.</color> After it is used on Evernight, increases the DMG dealt when Evey uses the Memosprite Skill "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew" by <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color>. After Evernight uses Skill/Ultimate, additionally gains <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak> "Memoria." The CRIT DMG boost effect provided by the Skill is further increased by an amount equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak></color> of Evernight's CRIT DMG.
1141524.simple_desc: <color=#f29e38ff>Effective for the entire battle.</color> After it is used on Evernight, increases the DMG dealt when Evey uses the Memosprite Skill "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew." After Evernight uses Skill/Ultimate, additionally gains "Memoria." The CRIT DMG boost effect provided by the Skill is further increased.

1141525.name: Ode to Earth
1141525.desc: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, grants "Ode to Earth" to Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, and enables the next <unbreak>#3[i]</unbreak> attack(s) of "Souldragon" to deal <u>Additional DMG</u> of the Bondmate's Type, equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#4[i]%</unbreak></color> of the Bondmate's Shield Effect. When Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae holds "Ode to Earth," the "Bondmate" deals <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[f1]%</unbreak></color> increased DMG. When used on Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, advances Souldragon's action by <unbreak>100%</unbreak>. Souldragon's next action gains the enhancement effect of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate and the Shield Effect provided by Souldragon is <unbreak>#5[i]%</unbreak> of its original Shield Effect. Does not consume the enhancement number of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate.
1141525.simple_desc: When Demiurge uses Memosprite Skill, "Souldragon" deals <u>Additional DMG</u> after attacking and Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae gains "Ode to Earth": The "Bondmate" deals increased DMG. When used on Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae, advances Souldragon's action, and enables Souldragon's next action to gain the enhancement effect of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Ultimate and increases the multiplier of the Shield provided.

1141526.desc: For every 1 different teammate (i.e., excluding Demiurge) from whom Cyrene has gained "Recollection," additionally deals 1 instance of Ice DMG equal to <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>#1[i]%</unbreak></color> of Demiurge's Max HP to one random enemy when Demiurge uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes." When "Story" reaches <unbreak>#2[i]</unbreak>, Demiurge consumes all "Story" points to immediately gain 1 <u>extra turn</u> and automatically use "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."
1141526.simple_desc: For every 1 different teammate (i.e., excluding Demiurge) from whom Cyrene has gained "Recollection," additionally deals 1 instance of DMG to one random enemy when Demiurge uses "Minuet of Blooms and Plumes."
